objections.q: Will an agent ever operate our switches?
objections.a: No. The OT safety rule caps the Fault Location & Restoration Advisor at L2: it proposes switching plans that a qualified operator checks against the as-operated model and executes. The runtime refuses any promotion above L2.

objections.q: We already have FLISR in the ADMS — why this?
objections.a: The advisor works across ADMS, OMS, AMI and GIS with a governed network model, and hands off to crews and customer communications. It complements ADMS automation; it does not replace it.
